item.title: Work
item.description:
I have worked as a software engineer since 2004, and have spent most of that time building web applications using a wide variety of programming languages.

I currently work at Enterprise Mobility , where I lead the development of solutions across our Commute and Carshare teams. At EHI, we generally create highly scaleable Java and PHP applications and deploy on AWS intrastructure.

I also run a small software company called Nehit that engages in occasional web application development on a per project basis.

item.title: Family
item.description:
I am fortunate to be part of an amazing family of four - myself, my wife Christina, and my children Jack and Max. I knew Christina growing up, but she only agreed to marry me after I had matured for an extra decade or so 🤣. She is a very smart, kind, and exceptionally beautiful woman and I’m incredibly lucky to have her!

My first born, Jack, is 9 years old and is a very clever, fun-loving third grader. He particularly enjoys Pokémon, soccer, football, and all things Atlanta—especially the Falcons.
